title: Linear bound on space use
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $c$ be a configuration for an input string, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The total number of distinct work-tape cells visited from $c$ through step $t$ is at most $k(t+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A machine with symbol alphabet and state set
An input string and a configuration for that input
